content.text:
I'm not choosing anything today. I'll ask you, or go to the branch with what I saw. I'm not sure of much, and the page wore me out before I got anywhere.

The one thing I took away: the page puts the same fund, "ילין לפידות מחקה S&P 500", at different banks and investment houses. At the top it marks "פסגות" with "★ הזול" and shows 86,492 ₪ after 10 years. That was on its own example of 10,000 ₪ now and 500 ₪ a month, which it adds up to 70,000 ₪. The big banks come out lower: לאומי 83,396, הפועלים 81,471, דיסקונט 79,901 and מזרחי טפחות 77,695. I've never heard of פסגות as a bank, and I wouldn't move money anywhere because of one website.

But it does bother me that the banks come out lower. If those numbers are right, our bank may be taking a few thousand shekels more over ten years. That's worth asking the clerk about.

**What I looked at, in order**
- **Screen 1.** The heading "איפה ואיך הכי זול להשקיע במדד". To me "מדד" is the price index on the news, so I wasn't sure what this was. Then buttons in English letters, "S&P 500" and "MSCI World". There were boxes with 10,000 ₪, 500 ₪ and 10 years, which I understood, and the big number 86,492 ₪.
- **Screen 2.** Coloured bars, and words like "דמי משמרת" and "עמלות זו על זו" that mean nothing to me. On the right is the list of banks with amounts. I read that part.
- **Screen 3.** A long list of funds with red minus signs: −447, −798, −1,268, −2,344, −3,671. I backed away from all of those.
- **Screen 4.** Whole lines in English, "iShares Core S&P 500 UCITS ETF", "Vanguard". At that point I stopped. I didn't go on to the other seven screens.

**What I didn't understand:** S&P 500, ETF, UCITS, "קרן מחקה", "קרן סל", "צוברת", "חשיפה לדולר", "עסקת החלף", "כמה דרכים יחד", "מס גם על שינוי המטבע", "דמי משמרת", "נאמן 0.02%", "4D", "אין שנה מלאה", "עוד לא נאסף", "TXF-11". Also the little grey lines under each bank's name, "מחיר אחר לצעירים..." and so on. They were too small and too dark to read properly.

**What bothered me**
- A small black window, "מס רק במכירה", sat on the left of every screen. It covered the numbers and never went away. I didn't understand what it said either.
- The whole page is dark, with pale grey writing.
- There are a lot of numbers, and minus signs in red and pink. That made me anxious.
- When it started with English letters I felt this site isn't for people like me.
- I didn't find anything saying whether this is as safe as a deposit. It just says "הבחירה שלכם; האתר לא ממליץ על מדד".
